text_en: Rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, and all guile, insincerity, envy, and all slander.
text_cn: 所以你们应放弃各种邪恶、各种欺诈、虚伪、嫉妒和各种诽谤，

text_en: Like newborn infants, long for the pure, spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow into salvation—
text_cn: 应如初生的婴儿贪求属灵性的纯奶，为使你们靠着它生长，以致得救；

text_en: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is good.
text_cn: 何况你们已尝到了“主是何等的甘饴”。

text_en: Come to him, a living stone, though rejected by mortals yet chosen and precious in God’s sight, and
text_cn: 你们接近了他，即接近了那为人所摈弃，但为天主所精选，所尊重的活石，

text_en: like living stones, let yourselves be built into a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 你们也就成了活石，建成一座属神的殿宇，成为一班圣洁的司祭，以奉献因耶稣基督而中悦天主的属神的祭品。

text_en: For it stands in scripture: “See, I am laying in Zion a stone, a cornerstone chosen and precious; and whoever believes in him will not be put to shame. ”
text_cn: 这就是经上所记载的：“看，我要在熙雍安放一块精选的，宝贵的基石，凡信赖他的，决不会蒙羞。”

text_en: To you then who believe, he is precious; but for those who do not believe, “The stone that the builders rejected has become the very head of the corner, ”
text_cn: 所以为你们信赖的人，是一种荣幸；但为不信赖的人，是“匠人弃而不用的石头，反而成了屋角的基石”；

text_en: and “A stone that makes them stumble, and a rock that makes them fall. ” They stumble because they disobey the word, as they were destined to do.
text_cn: 并且是“一块绊脚石，和一块使人跌倒的磐石”。他们由于不相信天主的话，而绊倒了，这也是为他们预定了的。

text_en: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God’s own people, in order that you may proclaim the mighty acts of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
text_cn: 至于你们，你们却是特选的种族，王家的司祭，圣洁的国民，属于主的民族，为叫你们宣扬那由黑暗中召叫你们，进入他奇妙之光者的荣耀。

text_en: Once you were not a people, but now you are God’s people; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
text_cn: 你们从前不是天主的人民，如今却是天主的人民；从前没有蒙受爱怜，如今却蒙受了爱怜。

text_en: Beloved, I urge you as aliens and exiles to abstain from the desires of the flesh that wage war against the soul.
text_cn: 亲爱的！我劝你们作侨民和作旅客的，应戒绝与灵魂作战的肉欲；

text_en: Conduct yourselves honorably among the Gentiles, so that, though they malign you as evildoers, they may see your honorable deeds and glorify God when he comes to judge.
text_cn: 在外教人中要常保持良好的品行，好使那些诽谤你们为作恶者的人，因见到你们的善行，而在主眷顾的日子，归光荣于天主。

text_en: For the Lord’s sake accept the authority of every human institution, whether of the emperor as supreme,
text_cn: 你们要为主的缘故，服从人立的一切制度：或是服从帝王为最高的元首，

text_en: or of governors, as sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do right.
text_cn: 或是服从帝王派遣来惩罚作恶者，奖赏行善者的总督，

text_en: For it is God’s will that by doing right you should silence the ignorance of the foolish.
text_cn: 因为这原是天主的旨意：要你们行善，使那些愚蒙无知的人，闭口无言。

text_en: As servants of God, live as free people, yet do not use your freedom as a pretext for evil.
text_cn: 你们要做自由的人，却不可做以自由为掩饰邪恶的人，但该做天主的仆人；

text_en: Honor everyone. Love the family of believers. Fear God. Honor the emperor.
text_cn: 要尊敬众人，友爱弟兄，敬畏天主，尊敬君王。

text_en: Slaves, accept the authority of your masters with all deference, not only those who are kind and gentle but also those who are harsh.
text_cn: 你们做家仆的，要以完全敬畏的心服从主人，不但对良善和温柔的，就是对残暴的，也该如此。

text_en: For it is a credit to you if, being aware of God, you endure pain while suffering unjustly.
text_cn: 谁若明知是天主的旨意，而忍受不义的痛苦：这才是中悦天主的事。

text_en: If you endure when you are beaten for doing wrong, what credit is that? But if you endure when you do right and suffer for it, you have God’s approval.
text_cn: 若你们因犯罪被打而受苦，那还有什么光荣？但若因行善而受苦，而坚心忍耐：这才是中悦天主的事。

text_en: For to this you have been called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, so that you should follow in his steps.
text_cn: 你们原是为此而蒙召的，因为基督也为你们受了苦，给你们留下了榜样，叫你们追随他的足迹。

text_en: “He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in his mouth. ”
text_cn: “他没有犯过罪，他口中也从未出过谎言”；

text_en: When he was abused, he did not return abuse; when he suffered, he did not threaten; but he entrusted himself to the one who judges justly.
text_cn: 他受辱骂，却不还骂；他受虐待，却不报复，只将自己交给那照正义行审判的天主；

text_en: He himself bore our sins in his body on the cross, so that, free from sins, we might live for righteousness; by his wounds you have been healed.
text_cn: 他在自己的身上，亲自承担了我们的罪过，上了木架，为叫我们死于罪恶，而活于正义；“你们是因他的创伤而获得了痊愈”。

text_en: For you were going astray like sheep, but now you have returned to the shepherd and guardian of your souls.
text_cn: 你们从前有如迷途的亡羊，如今却被领回，归依你们的灵牧和监督。
